observations: The top holds: Steal An Egg (91 days) leads ahead of The Hollow, Brookhaven, Murder Mystery 2, RIVALS and 99 Nights in the Forest.
Old horror games are the biggest risers: Flee the Facility +47 (9 years), DOORS +21 and Fisch +24, all tied to Halloween updates and, for DOORS and Flee the Facility, to The Hollow event.
Eight games entered, including Ragdoll Reality at 11 days, +1 Dance Battle Evolution at 33 days and the returning Piggy, Grow a Garden and Sell Lemons.
Young games fell: Paint to Get Rich -11, DIVINE HATCHERS -13, Fix My Phone! -14, Free Fire Zone (Max) -15, so the 2–9 week band keeps sliding (median percentile 34–46).
The age pattern is U-shaped again: 0–14 days at the 59th percentile and multi-year games at the 62nd, against 26–34 for games of 6 weeks to a year (H-mp-009).
patterns: Games left more than about 9 days without an update stay fewer days on the chart (r=-0.57 at the split), and recent updates go with higher peaks; 'Update at least weekly' holds at 65%.
Higher product and pass prices tend to go with longer presence (median product price above 475 R$ r=+0.41; median pass above 75 R$ r=+0.46).

Complexity goes with more days on the chart (rho=+0.24), and steal_defend_base (78), combat_pvp (66) and racing_driving (63) lead loops by median percentile while incremental_plus1 (30) and idle tycoons (33) trail.
A high favorite rate per visit goes with lower positions, a lifecycle marker of huge evergreens rather than a lever.

outliers.name: Steal An Egg
outliers.note: Tops the chart at 91 days while its steal/egg clones fade on every chart; first-mover scale, not the template, appears to carry it.

outliers.name: Flee the Facility
outliers.note: A 3,402-day game up 47 places, likely carried by The Hollow event and Halloween horror demand rather than a lasting change.

observations: Donation hubs (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS) again lead efficiency, followed by Elemental Dungeons, Spin a KPOP Idol and Westville Florida.
Efficiency rises with age: median percentile 32 at 15–42 days, 42 at 43–84 days, 56 at 85–122 days and 59 past a year (H-te-001 at 79%).
Moped Drag rose +197 after a big update and Candy Kingdom Defense +133 at 25 days; Backseat Rally +83 reached the chart but sits among the weakest per player.
Shoot For Eggs -80, Prehistoric Farm -41 and Karate Evolution -43 fell, again putting egg and +1 games among the weakest earners.
Thirteen games entered, including Undertale Adventures X, +1 Haki Evolution, Build a PC, Martial Arts World and the 6-year-old Regretevator.
patterns: A median developer product price above 79 R$ consistently goes with higher efficiency (r=+0.41 at the split), still the strongest page-level lever (H-te-005 at 81%).
RPGs (r=+0.49) and roleplay hubs (r=+0.35) consistently earn more per player; Simulation (r=-0.23) and solo loops (r=-0.22) earn less.
Complexity, longer descriptions, more passes and bigger servers all go with efficiency, with game age as a shared confounder.

'Egg' (r=-0.51), 'RP' (r=-0.35) and 'Steal' (r=-0.34) in titles go with lower efficiency, while roleplay loops go with higher, so the RP title signal likely reflects small clone towns rather than the loop.

outliers.name: [QOL🎃] Spin a KPOP Idol
outliers.note: A solo simulator among the most efficient, against both the solo and Simulation patterns; gacha spins on a fandom theme likely drive high spending per player.

outliers.name: Moped Drag [BIG UPDATE 🏍️]
outliers.note: Jumped 197 places in a day after a tagged big update, the largest single-day rise; an update-driven spending spike rather than a steady pattern.

observations: Ragdoll Reality (11 days) leads momentum at +42, followed by Adopt Your Animal! +39, RoChess!, +1 Dance Battle Evolution, Something is Wrong With My Dog... and Clone Baby Care (Anomaly).
The youngest games carry the most momentum: 0–14 days at the 81st percentile, 15–42 days at 59, 43–84 days at 43 and 85–122 days at 10.
Sixteen games entered, among them DOORS, Animal Hospital (Anomaly), AOONI Nightmare, Pave the Road, Drive a Cart Downhill! and Makeup All Stars, while RIVALS and Forsaken fell off.
The weakest are job sims heavy on passes: Make Ramen To Get Rich (22 passes), Clean the House! (33 passes) and Create a Robot Fighter.
patterns: Incremental mechanics tend to go with stronger momentum (r=+0.45, within-age +0.44; H-tt-034 at 60%), and a collection index with higher positions (H-tt-028 at 67%).
Thumbnails with text or big numbers (r=+0.31) and revive products (r=+0.30) go with momentum, while luck products go against it (r=-0.32); the first two are now proposed as hypotheses.

Shorter titles go with higher positions within age bands (-0.32), proposed as a hypothesis; a title event tag goes with higher positions (+0.38) even though tags may weaken momentum among the newest games.

simulation_job sits at the 11th median percentile, so everyday-job sims break out on Up-and-Coming but tend to stall here; launching with more than 8 passes tends to go with lower positions (H-tt-032 at 65%).

outliers.name: Musical Chairs 🎵🪑
outliers.note: A 736-day party game rose +30, outside the young-game population; short party formats keep re-surfacing older games.

outliers.name: RoChess!
outliers.note: A 73% like ratio and a competitive PvP loop, against both the like-ratio and PvP patterns, yet among the best for momentum; a familiar board game is an easy hook.

observations: DONT SPLASH (7 days) leads, ahead of Ragdoll Reality, The Hollow, Bike Universe, Backseat Rally and +1 Dance Battle Evolution.
Fifteen games entered, including A Long Flight, Throw Food For Animals, Beat Up Verity, Realistic Ragdoll Engine, Catch a Plane!, Stick Wars and Become A Striker.
+1 Upgrade Per Kill rose +51 despite a 50% like ratio, Drive a Cart Downhill! +46 and SQUISHY DUMPLING PRISON RUN! +40; Where Is Fahd? -33 and Stop The Train -29 fell.
Games 0–14 days sit at the 76th median percentile against 51 at 15–42 days and 39 at 43–84 days.
patterns: Games updated more recently consistently rank higher within age bands (H-uc-012 rose to 74%), and several updates a week tend to help (H-uc-015 at 65%).
Incremental mechanics (+0.40 within age), a collection index (+0.42; H-uc-033 at 68%) and everyday-life roleplay (H-uc-031 at 64%) go with higher positions.

Descriptions advertising redeem codes go with lower positions (within-age -0.30), the opposite of their Top Earning association, so codes may help revenue later rather than reach at launch; proposed as a hypothesis.
'Play with your friends' co-op pitches tend to rank lower (H-uc-013 at 68%), while racing_driving (73) and sandbox_physics (70) loops lead by median percentile.

outliers.name: [🎃] +1 Upgrade Per Kill
outliers.note: Rose 51 places with a 50% like ratio, against the like-ratio pattern; the +1 incremental hook appears to carry it despite poor reception.

outliers.name: [🎃] Facecard: Makeup Showdown (Junior)
outliers.note: A 98% like ratio at 3 days, yet among the weakest; a narrow audience and roleplay_social's low median here (20) likely explain it.

summary: Ragdoll Reality reached Up-and-Coming, Top Trending and Most Popular within 11 days, and Realistic Ragdoll Engine followed onto Up-and-Coming: a possible new physics-sandbox wave.
Games pull players first and monetize later: the youngest games lead Top Trending and Up-and-Coming while Top Earning efficiency climbs from the 32nd percentile at 15–42 days to the 59th past a year.

Incremental mechanics and collection indexes help on both breakout charts (Top Trending +0.45, Up-and-Coming +0.39) but '+1' titles still go with lower Top Earning efficiency, so they buy reach rather than revenue.
The Hollow and Halloween keep lifting horror games across charts (Flee the Facility, DOORS, Piggy), a seasonal confounder to watch after Oct 31.
progressions: tt→mp remains the most common transition (97 entries, median 2 days), followed by uc→tt (93, 2 days) and te→tt (63, 7 days).
uc→mp (61, 4 days), uc→te (58, 4 days) and tt→te (57, 4 days) show breakouts reaching dominance and revenue within a week, while tt→uc stays at 1.
